verdict.rationale: Whether an engine's source is readable under an open license is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Unity publishing its engine or editor source under an open license. The only open-source mention is the third-party VLC-Unity plugin, and the runtime probe notes the official MCP component has no public repo and is a closed distribution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
